description: Create a content automation rule from the configuration in body. Supports scheduled content generation and YouTube repurposing rules. Active rules generate content and can schedule or publish it according to their approval settings; returns the saved rule. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_create_content_automation
title: Create Content Automation
